How I Work

My Development Process

A structured approach I follow to deliver clean, reliable, and scalable full-stack applications.

📋
01

Understand

Analyze requirements, define scope, identify user needs and system goals clearly before writing any code.

🗺️
02

Architect

Design database schema, plan API endpoints, choose the right tech stack, and structure the project folder.

✏️
03

Build

Develop clean frontend with React, build robust REST APIs with Node.js and integrate database with Prisma or MySQL.

🧪
04

Test

Test APIs with Postman, end-to-end testing with Playwright, fix bugs, and ensure cross-browser compatibility.

🚀
05

Deploy

Deploy to production, monitor performance, update documentation, and iterate based on user feedback.
